title: Sales Growth & Performance Improvement
shortDescription: Strong Amazon sales growth achieved with 1,621 units ordered and $100,471.43 in sales during the selected period.
summary: Strong Amazon sales growth achieved with 1,621 units ordered and $100,471.43 in sales during the selected period.
caseStudyDetails:
Client Problem:

The client needed to improve Amazon sales performance and increase overall order volume compared with the previous period.

Our Solution:

1. Sales Performance Optimization
Focused on improving overall sales performance and increasing order volume.

2. Performance Monitoring
Monitored sales and order performance across the selected period to identify growth opportunities.

3. Growth Comparison
Compared current performance against the same date range from the previous year to measure sales and unit growth.

Results:

The selected period generated 1,621 units ordered and $100,471.43 in ordered product sales. Compared with the same period one year earlier, sales increased from $70,333.77 to $100,471.43, while units ordered increased from 1,071 to 1,621.

title: Resolving Brand Registry Challenges to Protect Client’s Brand
shortDescription: Successfully resolved Amazon Brand Registry issues, strengthened brand protection, and stabilized the client’s Amazon sales performance.
summary: Successfully resolved Amazon Brand Registry issues, strengthened brand protection, and stabilized the client’s Amazon sales performance.
caseStudyDetails:
Client Problem:

The client faced multiple issues during Amazon Brand Registry enrollment, including trademark verification complications, application delays, and registration errors. Without Brand Registry protection, the brand was vulnerable to unauthorized sellers and listing hijackers.

Our Solution:

1. Trademark Assistance
Guided the client through the trademark registration process and helped prepare the required documentation according to Amazon’s requirements.

2. Brand Registry Application Support
Reviewed and corrected the Brand Registry application, ensured the information matched Amazon’s guidelines, and followed up with Amazon to resolve delays.

3. Registration Error Resolution
Identified and corrected document and information inconsistencies that were causing application rejections and delays.

4. Brand Protection Setup
After successful enrollment, implemented Amazon Brand Registry protection tools, including IP protection and counterfeit reporting, to help secure the listings from unauthorized sellers and hijackers.

Results:

The client was successfully enrolled in Amazon Brand Registry within a few weeks, gained access to Brand Registry tools, and achieved improved brand protection and credibility. The sales dashboard shows 554 units ordered and $42,568.00 in ordered product sales, with 309 total order items.

title: Reducing ACoS from 181.43% to 49.07% in 5 Months
shortDescription: Reduced Amazon PPC ACoS from 181.43% to 49.07% in five months while increasing total sales through campaign optimization, budget control, and organic growth strategies.
summary: Reduced Amazon PPC ACoS from 181.43% to 49.07% in five months while increasing total sales through campaign optimization, budget control, and organic growth strategies.
caseStudyDetails:
Client Problem:

The brand was struggling with an extremely high ACoS of 181.43%, excessive ad spend, poor returns, weak campaign structure, limited organic growth, and inefficient bidding strategies.

Our Solution:

1. PPC Campaign Optimization
Restructured campaigns by separating high-converting, testing, and exploratory keywords. Eliminated irrelevant and high-ACoS keywords and shifted focus toward high-intent, long-tail keywords. Implemented manual and automated bidding strategies to improve efficiency.

2. ACoS Reduction & Budget Optimization
Reduced spend on unprofitable campaigns and reallocated budgets toward top-performing ads. Monitored keyword performance and made real-time bid adjustments while focusing on high-ROAS placements.

3. Organic Growth & Listing Enhancements
Improved product listings with high-quality images, keyword-optimized content, and A+ content. Leveraged influencer marketing and social media ads to increase organic sales and improved customer experience and reviews to support higher conversion rates.

Results:

ACoS was reduced from 181.43% to 49.07% in five months, while total sales increased from $1,075.61 to $8,997.16. Organic sales contribution also grew, reducing dependence on PPC, and conversion rate reached 12.06% in October.

title: Scaling to $46,487.44 in Sales with Just 13.89% ACoS
shortDescription: Scaled Amazon PPC sales to $46,487.44 in a single month while maintaining a highly efficient 13.89% ACoS through data-driven campaign optimization and strategic budget allocation.
summary: Scaled Amazon PPC sales to $46,487.44 in a single month while maintaining a highly efficient 13.89% ACoS through data-driven campaign optimization and strategic budget allocation.
caseStudyDetails:
Client Problem:

The brand was struggling with inefficient ad spend, high ACoS, poor keyword targeting, and inconsistent sales and profitability. The campaigns lacked a structured strategy and were not generating efficient returns.

Our Solution:

1. PPC Campaign Overhaul
Restructured campaigns by separating high-converting, medium-performance, and exploratory keywords. Shifted focus toward long-tail, high-intent keywords and used automated and manual bidding strategies to improve efficiency.

2. ACoS Optimization & Budget Allocation
Implemented a profit-driven bidding strategy to maintain a low ACoS while scaling sales. Reallocated budgets toward high-ROI placements and eliminated underperforming keywords and placements to reduce wasted spend.

3. Strategic Sales Scaling
Leveraged holiday-season opportunities to maximize sales during peak periods. Optimized product listings with SEO-driven content, engaging images, and persuasive bullet points, while using influencer marketing and email promotions to support sales growth.

Results:

Generated $46,487.44 in total sales with 1,543 orders in a single month. Ad spend was $6,458.53, while ACoS remained at 13.89%, supporting profitable growth and efficient scaling.

title: New Single SKU Product Launch with Rapid Growth in Under 2 Months
shortDescription: Launched a new single-SKU Amazon product and achieved rapid sales growth within two months through listing optimization, efficient PPC, and organic growth strategies.
summary: Launched a new single-SKU Amazon product and achieved rapid sales growth within two months through listing optimization, efficient PPC, and organic growth strategies.
caseStudyDetails:
Client Problem:

The client wanted to launch a completely new Amazon product under a single SKU and generate sales traction quickly within a limited budget. With no historical data, reviews, or organic ranking, the main challenge was building visibility and conversions.

Our Solution:

1. Market Research & Positioning
Identified a high-demand, low-competition product and optimized the pricing strategy to remain competitive while maintaining profitability.

2. Supply Chain & Inventory Management
Sourced the product through trusted suppliers with fast turnaround times and minimized lead time and shipping costs to maintain healthy margins.

3. High-Converting Listing Optimization
Designed high-quality product images, an engaging title, and keyword-rich bullet points to improve click-through and conversion rates. Implemented A+ Content to strengthen product credibility and the buyer experience.

4. Cost-Efficient PPC Strategy
Launched structured PPC campaigns focused on high-intent keywords, optimized bids, and used negative keyword filtering to reduce wasted ad spend while maintaining a profitable ACoS.

5. Organic Ranking & Sales Growth
Increased early sales velocity through external traffic and promotional strategies, secured initial customer reviews, and balanced paid and organic traffic for sustainable growth.

Results:

In less than 2 months, the single-SKU product generated $6,199.24 in sales with 325 units ordered. The average sales per order reached $19.31, while the product established a strong foundation for long-term organic ranking and growth.

title: Successful Launch & Scaling of a New Brand on a Limited Budget
shortDescription: Launched and scaled a new Amazon brand on a limited budget through strategic product selection, cost-effective sourcing, PPC optimization, and organic ranking strategies.
summary: Launched and scaled a new Amazon brand on a limited budget through strategic product selection, cost-effective sourcing, PPC optimization, and organic ranking strategies.
caseStudyDetails:
Client Problem:

The client wanted to launch a new Amazon brand with a limited budget while achieving strong sales and maintaining a healthy profit margin. The main challenge was ranking a new product on the first page without excessive advertising spend.

Our Solution:

1. Market Research & Product Selection
Identified a low-saturation, high-demand product and analyzed competitor pricing, reviews, and keyword trends to ensure strong product-market fit.

2. Cost-Effective Sourcing & Supply Chain Optimization
Worked with local agents in China to source the product at a low MOQ and optimized logistics to reduce lead time and shipping costs.

3. Strategic Launch & PPC Optimization
Created an optimized Amazon listing with high-converting images, compelling copy, and well-researched keywords. Implemented a targeted PPC strategy and used negative keywords and bid adjustments to control ad spending.

4. Ranking & Organic Growth Strategy
Leveraged external traffic to generate initial sales momentum, focused on keyword-optimized sales and conversion rates, and gradually scaled PPC while maintaining profitability.

Results:

The product successfully ranked on the first page for primary keywords. It achieved 2,632 total orders and £54,733.43 in sales, with an average sales per order of £20.80. The brand also established a sustainable growth model with minimal advertising costs.

title: High ACoS Optimization for Improved Profitability
shortDescription: Reduced ACoS through PPC campaign optimization, negative keyword targeting, bid adjustments, and strategic ad expansion.
summary: Reduced ACoS through PPC campaign optimization, negative keyword targeting, bid adjustments, and strategic ad expansion.
caseStudyDetails:
Client Problem:

The client was facing a high Advertising Cost of Sales (ACoS), which was affecting profitability. Despite running multiple PPC campaigns, the ads were not converting effectively, resulting in higher costs and declining ROI.

Our Solution:

1. Campaign Audit
Conducted an in-depth audit of existing PPC campaigns to identify underperforming keywords, placements, and ad types.

2. Negative Keywords
Added negative keywords to eliminate irrelevant traffic that was consuming the budget without generating conversions.

3. Bid Adjustments
Optimized bids based on performance by reducing bids for low-converting keywords and reallocating budget toward high-performing keywords.

4. Sponsored Brands & Sponsored Display
Launched Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display Ads alongside Sponsored Products to increase product visibility and attract targeted audiences.

Results:

ACoS was reduced from 61.72% to 31.98%, while overall ad sales increased by 37%. The improvements resulted in better cost efficiency and profitability.

title: Product Listing Optimization for Increased Visibility
shortDescription: Improved Amazon product visibility and organic ranking through competitor analysis, keyword optimization, listing enhancement, and A/B testing.
summary: Improved Amazon product visibility and organic ranking through competitor analysis, keyword optimization, listing enhancement, and A/B testing.
caseStudyDetails:
• Client Problem:

The product had low visibility and poor organic ranking despite being high quality. It was not reaching the target audience effectively and was getting low clicks and conversions.

Our Solution:

1. Competitor Analysis
Analyzed top competitors to identify ranking keywords and listing strategies.

2. Keyword Optimization
Researched and incorporated high-search-volume, relevant keywords into the product title, bullet points, and description.

3. Listing Enhancement
Improved product images and infographics and restructured bullet points to highlight unique features and benefits.

4. A/B Testing
Tested different titles and images and selected the highest-performing versions to improve conversions.

Results:

Within 30 days, the product moved from the third page to the first page for primary keywords. Sales increased by 45%, click-through rate improved by 20%, and ACoS was 40.74%
